architecture.mechanism: Optimization of clutch parameters to attenuate torsional vibration in the powertrain system
architecture.intervention: Recalibrate the 2020 Subaru Forester Lineartronic CVT lock-up clutch engagement pressure and slip rate profile during deceleration events to dampen torsional resonance, implemented via a transmission control module software update that does not trigger diagnostic trouble codes or alter ABS/VDC safety system logic.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of the 3-second unintended acceleration and vibration event during deceleration by suppressing torsional resonance through optimized clutch damping, restoring normal deceleration without illuminating warning lights or affecting vehicle safety systems.
architecture.falsification_test: Conduct a chassis dynamometer test replicating the deceleration profile from 40 km/h to 0 km/h while measuring driveline torque oscillations with strain gauges; failure is indicated if torsional vibration amplitude exceeds 5 Nm or if any wheel speed deviation consistent with unintended acceleration is recorded after the software calibration is applied.
